note: Every layer of the chorus 1 test, painted separately in the medium Robin picked from the style board (painted paper layers). Image 1 (work/style_ref.png, the board's paper liftoff plate) is attached to every call as the style reference.
style: Image 1 is a style reference only: match its medium exactly (cut and torn hand-painted papers layered like a paper theatre, visible brush texture and paper fibre, crisp scissor edges on buildings, soft torn edges on hills and clouds, warm windows glowing as if lit through thin paper). Do not copy its composition. No people. No text, no letters, no logos.

sky.prompt: A tall sky backdrop: one painted paper sheet with a few torn paper cloud strips glued on. Warm orange and peach at the very bottom, rising through rose and violet to deep night blue at the top, tiny cut paper stars only in the top third. Nothing else: no land, no buildings, no rocket. Full bleed, no border.

hills.prompt: Only a long strip of far rolling hills in torn painted paper: two or three overlapping torn layers in muted green and dusky blue-violet, the hilltops in the middle of the image, the hills reaching down to the bottom edge, edge to edge left to right. Transparent background above the hills: do not paint any sky. Nothing else.

town.prompt: Only a band of a small brick town seen from a rooftop at dusk: many low red brick buildings and terraced rooftops with chimneys and a few water tanks, warm lit windows, every building its own cut paper shape. The rooftops start just below the middle of the image and the buildings reach the bottom edge, edge to edge. Transparent background above the rooftops: no sky, no hills.

roof.prompt: Only the near foreground: the flat rooftop we stand on, its low red brick parapet wall running across the bottom third of the image edge to edge, a brick chimney stack on the far left, an old wooden water tank on legs on the far right, a TV aerial, and a laundry line with three cloths strung between two poles. The middle of the roof is open and empty. Transparent background above everything: no sky, no town behind.

rocket.prompt: Only a small toy rocket ship standing upright in the centre: a rounded red-and-cream body made of cut painted paper pieces, one round porthole with a warm lit window, three red fins, a small dark nozzle at the bottom. No flame, no smoke, no shadow. Transparent background, nothing else.

flame.prompt: Only a rocket flame pointing straight down: a long teardrop of layered cut paper, pale yellow inside, then orange, then red at the torn outer edge. Its wide top end at the top centre of the image, its tip pointing down. Transparent background, nothing else.

puff.prompt: Only one round puff of smoke made of four overlapping torn pieces of cream and pale grey painted paper, with soft shadows between the pieces. Centred. Transparent background, nothing else.

cloud_warm.prompt: Only one long horizontal bank of cloud made of torn painted paper: several overlapping torn strips in peach, rose and lavender, lit warm from below, spanning the full width edge to edge, thick in the middle, torn along the top and bottom. Transparent background above and below. Nothing else.

cloud_cool.prompt: Only one long horizontal bank of evening cloud made of torn painted paper: many overlapping torn strips in cool blue-grey, dusty violet and a little pale pink, spanning the full width edge to edge, thick in the middle, torn along the top and bottom. Transparent background above and below. Nothing else.

cloud_sheet.prompt: A single solid wall of thick cloud filling the whole frame edge to edge, made of many layered torn painted paper strips in blue-grey, slate violet and soft lavender, darker towards the top. No gaps, no sky showing, no border.

night.prompt: A night sky backdrop: one deep blue painted paper sheet with a faint torn paper band of lighter violet across it like the Milky Way, many tiny cut paper stars and a few larger four-point stars. Nothing else: no land, no moon, no rocket. Full bleed, no border.

world.prompt: Only a small round world seen from space, like a little planet made of layered cut and torn painted papers: a small brick town with warm lit windows wrapped around the top of the ball, rolling green and violet hills around the sides, a tiny river and a few trees, in late dusk light. The ball fills most of the image, centred. Transparent background around the ball: no stars, no sky.
